scope: Read-only original workspace snapshot; aggregate report without the full per-file array.

size_semantics.logical: lstat.st_size; totals distinguish regular files from symlink link-string lengths.
size_semantics.allocated: lstat.st_blocks*512; sum is filesystem-reported allocation, not unique physical APFS clone/dedup storage. Directory allocation is reported separately. Unique inode allocation avoids hardlink double-counting.
size_semantics.directory_totals: Recursive descendant file-entry logical and allocated bytes; directories overlap and cannot be summed.

notes: Empty reachable history does not claim anything about remote repositories; no remote was contacted.
Untracked/ignored files are working-copy inventory, not committed history.

portable_candidate_snapshot.scope_note: Separate later candidate-selection snapshot, not part of the original workspace scan. Regenerated manifests can include subsequent documentation; use the final manifest for final candidate totals.

interpretation_notes: All bytes are exact integer bytes; human sizes use IEC KiB/MiB/GiB (1024 powers).
Recursive directories overlap; nested rows cannot be added. Overlapping tags and requested views cannot be added either.
Exclusive categories assign each file entry once; their sum equals all_file_entry_logical_bytes. Tag and extension views can cross those categories.
Model/cache/skills/templates tags are filename/path heuristics and include dependency contents. Requested exact directory views distinguish primary roots from those broad tags.
The model tag includes model-related package files; exact model stores are voice/chatterbox/model and .cache/whisper. The latter is also a cache.
Root .git is 33,407 logical bytes. The larger git_metadata category also includes nested Git metadata and is not the root repository history size.
No videolar directory was present in the repository or its inspected parent during the original audit; parent held video-engine and .DS_Store.
Allocated sums use st_blocks*512 and do not determine APFS clone/dedup physical ownership. Unique inode allocation only avoids hardlink double counting.
Inventory and Git listing are separate read-only observations in a non-atomic scan; concurrent file changes can explain count differences.
No commits, index entries, refs, object packs or history blobs exist in this repository snapshot. Remote repository state was not inspected.
Generated inventory, audit, clean-clone and later implementation files were not retroactively added to original-workspace totals.
